request: Build a small Jac web app for two-player tic-tac-toe matches. Several matches can run at once, each with its own board and current player. Players take turns claiming cells; a match ends with a winner on a row, column or diagonal, or a draw when the board is full. The last move can be undone while the match is still running.
acceptance: A move by the player whose turn it is not, or onto an occupied cell, is rejected and the board is unchanged.
A ninth move that completes a line is a win, not a draw.
Any move or undo after the match has ended is rejected.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
